title: Bubble Shooter 3D
description: A free bubble shooter in three dimensions for Windows and the Raspberry Pi 5: fire at a cluster that hangs from a glass ceiling and sways under real physics, and whatever you cut loose falls. 140 levels in 14 chapters, each in a scene of its own.
author: Antonín Pražský
piPicture: no shadows, no clouds and no post effects, but every chapter still has its scenery behind the island, in a simpler form
